common.reason: You are receiving this message because you have a Maki Story account.

magic_link.subject: Your Maki Story sign-in link
magic_link.preheader: Tap the button to sign in. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.
magic_link.title: Your magic link
magic_link.p2: Tap the button to sign in to Maki Story. No password needed.
magic_link.note: This link is valid for {minutes} minutes and works only once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message.

invitation.subject: {name} invites you to join {family} on Maki Story
invitation.preheader: Lend your voice to the family’s stories. Join in one tap.
invitation.title: {name} invites you to join {family}
invitation.p1: {name} invites you to join the family as a [[{role}]].
invitation.p2: On Maki Story, everyone lends their voice to the children’s bedtime stories, even from far away.
invitation.note: You can also enter the code **{code}** when you create your profile. It is valid for {hours} h.

code_reset.subject: Choose a new Maki Story code
code_reset.preheader: This link is valid for {minutes} minutes.
code_reset.title: A new code?
code_reset.p1: You asked to reset your secret code.
code_reset.p2: Tap the button to choose a new one.
code_reset.note: If you did not make this request, ignore this message: your current code stays valid.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Maki Story!
welcome.preheader: Your family is ready. Here is how to start.
welcome.title: Welcome, {name}!
welcome.p2: To start: invite a relative, add a first story, then let the magic of voices begin.

review_request.subject: {name} recorded “{book}”
review_request.preheader: Lines are waiting for your review.
review_request.title: A story is waiting for your review
review_request.p2: Lines to review: {count}. You can approve each line or ask for a change.
review_request.reason: You are receiving this e-mail because you are a parent in a family on Maki Story.

corrections.subject: Takes to redo on “{book}”
corrections.title: A few takes to redo
corrections.reason: You are receiving this e-mail because you recorded a voice on this story.

new_voice.subject: {name} left a message for {child}
new_voice.title: A new message for {child}
new_voice.p2: It is waiting in their inbox, on their home screen.
new_voice.reason: You are receiving this e-mail because you turned on new voice notifications.

export_ready.subject: Your Maki Story data export is ready
export_ready.preheader: The download link is valid for {days} days.
export_ready.title: Your export is ready
export_ready.p1: You asked for a copy of your data: recordings, profiles and reading progress.
export_ready.note: The link is valid for {days} days. Do not share it: it gives access to your data.

account_deleted.subject: Your Maki Story account has been deleted
account_deleted.preheader: Confirmation that your account and data were deleted.
account_deleted.title: Your account has been deleted
account_deleted.p1: As requested, your account and all the data of the **{family}** family have been deleted.
account_deleted.p2: Thank you for sharing stories with us. You are always welcome back.
account_deleted.note: If you did not ask for this deletion, write to us right away at {support}.
account_deleted.noteNoContact: If you did not ask for this deletion, reply to this message right away.

digest.subject: Your Maki Story daily summary
digest.title: Your daily summary
digest.p1: Here is what happened on Maki Story since yesterday.
digest.more: And {count} more updates in the app.
digest.reason: You receive a single summary e-mail per day, because you turned on e-mail notifications.

digestLine.recording_request: You are asked to record your voice for “{bookTitle}”.
